messages:
maya: seeing repeated node-to-node latency spikes during peak batching windows on us-west-2 GPU pool. p95 inter-GPU RTT jumps from ~4-7ms to 140-240ms for ~20-40s during batch ramp. noticed around 10:48 and 11:12.

jon: nice catch. are these correlated with a specific machine class or NIC firmware?

maya: mostly rtx-a5000 boxes (nodepool-gpu-large) with mellanox mlx5, fw 25.2000. flow shows increase in retransmits and rx_errors on nic counters.

ahmad: can you share the counter dump? rx_errors/retransmits would point to link flaps or MTU mismatch.

maya: paste: ```shell
# ethtool -S mlx5_core | egrep "rx_errors|tx_errors|rx_discards|tx_dropped"
rx_errors: 0
tx_errors: 0
rx_discards: 176
tx_dropped: 12
```
Also tcp_retrans: see socket stats jump in netstat.

tara: any RDMA logs? was RDMA enabled for these nodes?

maya: yes we use kernel rdma for GPUDirect in this pool. /var/log/messages around event: "mlx5_core 0000:07:00.0: qptype qp1 loss detected". short snippet: ```
Mar 12 10:48:13 node-045 mlx5_core: qp1 loss detected, rearming link
Mar 12 10:48:32 node-045 kernel: IB CM: QP error state
```

jon: hmm qp errors + rx_discards suggests intermittent packetization issues. MTU mismatch between hosts or intermediate switch could cause fragmentation. What's the configured MTU on the nodes and TOR?

maya: nodes: ip link show eth0 -> mtu 9000. ToR shows 1500 in SNMP dump we pulled earlier.

ahmad: bingo. jumbo frames on hosts but ToR set to 1500 = fragmentation on switches -> perf drops during big batched transfers. explains why only during heavy batching windows.

tara: do we have perf counters per-batch size? maybe larger prompt lengths cause bigger packets.

maya: yes, observed correlation with average sequence length 1024+ and batch sizes ramping >64. CPU softirq and NIC transmit queue length spike.

jon: mitigation steps?

maya: short term: roll back host MTU to 1500 on affected pool, or enable jumbo on ToR (needs network change window). I started a canary to set MTU=1500 on 3 nodes in pool and will monitor.

ops-bot: Created ticket RF-2312: "Inter-GPU latency spikes - MTU mismatch investigation" assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RF-2312

ahmad: also double-check RDMA path's vfrags/segmentation offload settings. if GSO/TSO are on while MTU mismatched, more badness.

maya: test command I used: ```shell
# ping -M do -s 8972 <peer-ip>
PING ...: Message too long
```
So fragmentation failing.

tara: nice catch. after the canary, we should schedule net change to enable 9000 on ToR or standardize host MTU to 1500 depending on risk.

jon: are there billing/capacity impacts? high retransmits increase CPU and token latency -> cost.

maya: yes 10-15% higher p99 tail and GPU utilization drops because waiting on comms; made note in incident notes.

ahmad: I'll run iperf RDMA test on a few nodes during next window to confirm.

maya: will update RF-2312 with measurements and dump. pushing MTU canary now, will report in 5m. :thumbsup:

jon: thanks. @tara please coordinate with network for scheduled change if canary confirms.
